Builds the 1Ah-byte name shaderfx/shaderpreload.lua, runs it through 00b69d40, opens table key FileNames via 00b67800, logs '--- SHADER LOADING BEGIN ---', then iterates with 00b67080/00b67190/00b66420/00b662b0. Each entry name goes to renderer virtual +48h (00b318b0, RET 4), the effect loader that rewrites .mshd to .shfx and resolves through the registry at renderer+1A98h (docs/MATERIAL_DISPATCH.md), so the 'shader cache' is the renderer effect registry rather than a separate object. Each returned handle is appended to the application vector at +8h data, +0Ch size, +10h capacity, grown by doubling through 00735ec0 with a floor of 1. Closes with '--- SHADER LOADING END  ---'. Evidence: docs/APP_INIT_RENDERER.md; reports/app_init_renderer.json.
